title: AutoBench-V: Can Large Vision-Language Models Benchmark Themselves?

bias_targets.methodology: Intentionally placing all correct answers in option A and comparing the deviation in model performance against a baseline where correct answers are evenly distributed across all options (A, B, C, D) to assess if models have a preference for selecting the first option.

Comparing the performance variance of models when evaluated by a single LVLM examiner versus a diverse pool of multiple LVLM examiners to measure if models achieve artificially inflated scores on questions they generated themselves.
